## Tested revision and evidence

PR [#274](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-web/pull/274), head `f2ccb91f3db62fa404e3d10b0af386612ebc5412` (still current when rechecked on 2026-10-28 at approximately 17:03 UTC).

Both final-head jobs in run 40728719161 finished with **850 passing and 2 failing tests**:
- [Node 22, job 122958888834](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-web/actions/runs/40728719161/job/122958888834), completed 16:55:15 UTC.
- [Node 26, job 122958890207](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-web/actions/runs/40728719161/job/122958890207), completed 16:50:44 UTC.

This is hosted CI evidence plus exact-source inspection, not a claim that these full integration suites were rerun locally or that the draft PR is deployed.

## 1. The named compatibility matrix depends on the host installation

The new [item-history-versions test](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-web/blob/f2ccb91f3db62fa404e3d10b0af386612ebc5412/test/item-history-versions.test.ts#L21-L28) uses the repository's existing `node_modules/@unbrained/pm-cli` for the 2026.10.20 case and only materializes other named versions into separate prefixes. In both CI jobs, the package at that location is 2026.10.23. The strict assertion fails at line 28:

```text
actual:   '2026.10.23'
expected: '2026.10.20'
```

The test correctly refuses to mislabel the artifact, but this means CI does not complete the promised .20/.27/.28 compatibility matrix. Expected: every named version is obtained and verified independently of the consumer's current dependency installation, without changing the project's certified pins.

## 2. The new summary projection breaks an existing history consumer assertion

The real HTTP lifecycle test [pm-collaboration.test.ts:516–518](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-web/blob/f2ccb91f3db62fa404e3d10b0af386612ebc5412/test/pm-collaboration.test.ts#L516-L518) retrieves history after a mutation with reason `exercise update flags`, then expects that reason in the response. The new route returns only index/timestamp/action/author rows. Both jobs receive a successful page containing create/update/comment_add/note_add/append, but no reason, and fail the assertion.

Patch-free summaries and bounded default output are useful. The unresolved part is how a consumer explicitly retrieves historical mutation reasons/detail after the API contract change. Do not treat simply deleting the assertion as evidence that the complete lifecycle capability is preserved. This does **not** show that persisted history was erased; it shows that an existing HTTP retrieval contract no longer exposes the expected fact.

## Scope, owner and acceptance

The canonical [pm-web-lgg5 item](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-web/blob/f2ccb91f3db62fa404e3d10b0af386612ebc5412/.agents/pm/issues/pm-web-lgg5.toon) explicitly requires real .20/.27/.28 output and full npm/Bun gate evidence. It remains in progress. [pm-web-f3xo](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-web/blob/f2ccb91f3db62fa404e3d10b0af386612ebc5412/.agents/pm/issues/pm-web-f3xo.toon) separately owns backwards-cursor efficiency; this report does not duplicate that work or upstream ordering issue unbraind/pm-cli#1617.

- Materialize and assert each claimed compatibility version in isolated directories, including 2026.10.20, independently of the host dependency version. Preserve existing project pins.
- Run all nine documented projection cases on Node 22 and Node 26 rather than stopping at the first version assertion.
- Keep compact paginated defaults, but explicitly preserve historical reason/detail retrieval through an authorized supported projection or detail path, or document an accepted API migration and its equivalent retrieval mechanism.
- Update lifecycle tests to exercise both bounded summary behavior and the retained reason/detail capability. Preserve membership checks, typed refusals, append-safe pagination and stale-cursor behavior.
- Re-run the full npm/Bun gates on the final immutable head and record completed counts. Keep failed, pending and superseded results distinct.

Independent bounded verification passed 17 extracted-helper checks across this history implementation and the separate Ops #224 review. The Web subset passed 8 checks for ordering, bounds, 125-row pagination across an append, cursor scope/staleness and truthful errors. Those mocked-boundary helper checks do not override the real integration failures above.

Duplicate check: reviewed all 274 all-status repository issues/PRs, current #274 conversation and inline review comments, and both linked PM records. No existing issue records this pair of current CI failures. Closed #249 concerns an unrelated browser-baseline declaration fixture. The existing CodeQL comment is a separate scanner finding and is not duplicated or classified as a validated vulnerability here.
